Why Learn PWM?

Master the Language of Vehicle Power

Pulse Width Modulation (PWM) is the primary method for controlling power delivery in modern vehicles. From radiator fans to fuel pumps, understanding PWM signals is essential for diagnosing and repairing automotive electrical systems.

Diagnose Components

Learn to diagnose PWM-controlled components with a multimeter or oscilloscope. Identify faulty transistors, voltage irregularities, and signal issues in automotive systems.

Design Controllers

Design custom motor speed controllers with Arduino/ESP32. Generate PWM signals with specific duty cycles and frequencies to control actuators, fans, pumps, and lighting systems.

Read Schematics

Read automotive wiring schematics and identify PWM control lines. Trace power paths, understand switch positioning (low-side vs high-side), and trace faults in vehicle electrical systems.

Start Your PWM Journey

Join over 15,000 students who have mastered PWM diagnostics and repair. Structured lessons taking you from fundamentals to advanced applications.
